description.value: The Sandman Inn Cranbrook is a full-service hotel on Cranbrook Street North, part of the national Sandman Hotels chain, featuring an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant. The property has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Room options include studios with full kitchens, making it a practical base for multi-day touring cyclists needing space to prepare food.

address.value: 405 Cranbrook Street North, Cranbrook, BC V1C 3R5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms this is a real, open Sandman hotel in Cranbrook with a Denny's restaurant on-site, free Wi-Fi throughout, and USB charging ports in rooms. No mention anywhere of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, laundry, or e-bike charging. A name discrepancy exists: OSM uses 'Sandman Inn Cranbrook' while the website consistently uses 'Sandman Hotel Cranbrook'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Sandman Inn Cranbrook' but the website consistently identifies the property as 'Sandman Hotel Cranbrook' throughout all pages including the page title and room subpages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a confirmed web presence and active room listings. Useful to touring cyclists for overnight stays, on-site dining, and pool/fitness amenities.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Denny's Restaurant listed as a dining option in amenities and individual room pages

Device charging.detail: USB Charging Ports listed as a standard room feature on the individual room detail page
